ja: 2階- 状態異常きのみ・なつき度きのみ

ja: 3階- ニッチどうぐI; 効果延長どうぐ

en: Fourth Floor- Consumable Items; Special I
ja: 4階- 消耗どうぐ; スペシャルI

en: Fifth Floor- Mid-tier General Needs; Vitamins
ja: 5階- 中ランク一般用品; 栄養ドリンク

key: Sixth Floor- Type Berries
en: Sixth Floor- Type Berries
ja: 6階- タイプきのみ

key: Seventh Floor- Type Gems
en: Seventh Floor- Type Gems
ja: 7階- タイプジュエル

key: Eighth Floor- Battle Items; Niche Items II
en: Eighth Floor- Battle Items; Niche Items II
ja: 8階- バトルどうぐ; ニッチどうぐII

key: Ninth Floor- Evolution Stones; Special II
en: Ninth Floor- Evolution Stones; Special II
ja: 9階- 進化の石; スペシャルII

key: Tenth Floor- Top-tier General Needs; Rare Berries
en: Tenth Floor- Top-tier General Needs; Rare Berries
ja: 10階- 高ランク一般用品; レアきのみ

key: Eleventh Floor- Utility Items; Evolution Items
en: Eleventh Floor- Utility Items; Evolution Items
ja: 11階- 便利どうぐ; 進化どうぐ

key: Department Penthouse- Exclusive rest and relaxation
en: Department Penthouse- Exclusive rest and relaxation
ja: デパート最上階- 会員専用の　いこいの空間

key: Please enjoy your shopping experience!
en: Please enjoy your shopping experience!
ja: どうぞ　お買い物を　お楽しみください!

key: I do wish I could find more Stickers for my Membership Card.
en: I do wish I could find more Stickers for my Membership Card.
ja: メンバーズカード用のシールを　もっと　見つけたいものだ

key: They're so rare!
en: They're so rare!
ja: 本当に　珍しいからな!

key: At least they give out one of them right here...
en: At least they give out one of them right here...
ja: せめて　ここで　ひとつ　もらえるがな……

key: I saw a girl and her friend grab one recently.
en: I saw a girl and her friend grab one recently.
ja: 最近　女の子と　その友だちが　ひとつ　手に入れるのを見たぞ

key: Figure they must live on the other side of town, the way they were complaining about the weight of their shopping bags.
en: Figure they must live on the other side of town, the way they were complaining about the weight of their shopping bags.
ja: 買い物袋の重さに　文句を言っていたから　街の反対側に住んでいるのだろう

key: Yet, based on the abundance of sales tags, it can't be too upscale.
en: Yet, based on the abundance of sales tags, it can't be too upscale.
ja: だが　安売りの札の多さからして　高級な地区ではあるまい

key: Peridot Ward for certain.
en: Peridot Ward for certain.
ja: 間違いなく　ペリドットワードだ

key: I saw a woman my age pick one up just recently.
en: I saw a woman my age pick one up just recently.
ja: つい最近　わたしと同じくらいの年の女性が　ひとつ手にするのを見た

key: But she immediately pranced off after her child before I could ask where!
en: But she immediately pranced off after her child before I could ask where!
ja: だが　どこでと聞く前に　子どもを追って　行ってしまった!

key: She had the well-to-do air of someone from the Lapis Ward...
en: She had the well-to-do air of someone from the Lapis Ward...
ja: ラピスワードの人間らしい　裕福な雰囲気だった……

key: But the child was completely different!
en: But the child was completely different!
ja: だが　子どもの方は　まるで違った!

key: He seemed like he enjoyed playing in more rough and tumble areas like the Abandoned Power Plant!
en: He seemed like he enjoyed playing in more rough and tumble areas like the Abandoned Power Plant!
ja: 廃発電所のような　荒っぽい場所で　遊ぶのが好きそうだった!

key: What an odd duo.
en: What an odd duo.
ja: 妙な二人組だ

key: I saw a lady and her boyfriend carry one out of here recently...
en: I saw a lady and her boyfriend carry one out of here recently...
ja: 最近　女性と　その恋人が　ひとつ持って出るのを見た……

key: If I remember, she went into the Obsidia Pokécenter...
en: If I remember, she went into the Obsidia Pokécenter...
ja: たしか　オブシディアポケモンセンターに　入っていったな……

key: I wonder how they're doing now.
en: I wonder how they're doing now.
ja: 今ごろ　どうしているだろうな

key: I saw a young lady get one recently.
en: I saw a young lady get one recently.
ja: 最近　若い女性が　ひとつ手に入れるのを見た

key: She was dressed like a student of Apophyll Academy.
en: She was dressed like a student of Apophyll Academy.
ja: アポフィルアカデミーの生徒のような　服装だった

key: She was carrying several shopping bags though-- must be the impulsive type.
en: She was carrying several shopping bags though-- must be the impulsive type.
ja: 買い物袋を　いくつも抱えていたが――衝動買いする性格だろうな

key: I saw a young woman carry one out of here recently...
en: I saw a young woman carry one out of here recently...
ja: 最近　若い女性が　ひとつ持って出るのを見た……

key: She practically tripped out of the elevator-- must be the sort that's accident prone.
en: She practically tripped out of the elevator-- must be the sort that's accident prone.
ja: エレベーターから　転がり出るように出てきた――そそっかしい性格だろう

key: She said someone would be picking her up to take her back to Spinel Town soon though...
en: She said someone would be picking her up to take her back to Spinel Town soon though...
ja: もうすぐ　迎えが来て　スピネルタウンへ帰ると　言っていたが……

key: Surely she can't get in too much trouble in a place like that.
en: Surely she can't get in too much trouble in a place like that.
ja: あんな場所なら　たいした面倒には　ならんだろう

key: I saw a sharply-dressed man walk away with one recently.
en: I saw a sharply-dressed man walk away with one recently.
ja: 最近　きちんとした身なりの男が　ひとつ持って行くのを見た

key: He had some pretty notable glasses on!
en: He had some pretty notable glasses on!
ja: かなり目立つメガネを　かけていたぞ!

key: Must be the type who stares at a screen all day.
en: Must be the type who stares at a screen all day.
ja: 一日中　画面を　にらんでいる手合いだろう

key: But then, all he bought was products for outdoors and hiking?
en: But then, all he bought was products for outdoors and hiking?
ja: だが　買ったのは　野外用や登山用の品ばかりだった?

key: Maybe he works at some kind of Nature Center...
en: Maybe he works at some kind of Nature Center...
ja: ネイチャーセンターのような所で　働いているのかもしれん……

key: I saw a young mother pick one up a few days ago.
en: I saw a young mother pick one up a few days ago.
ja: 数日前　若い母親が　ひとつ手にするのを見た

key: She seemed to be terribly stressed out though, and I can understand why!
en: She seemed to be terribly stressed out though, and I can understand why!
ja: ひどく疲れきった様子だったが　理由は　よく分かる!

key: Her child seemed like an absolute menace.
en: Her child seemed like an absolute menace.
ja: あの子どもは　とんでもない　手におえない子だった

key: Demanding whatever they wanted, lying to people, and asking for freebies...
en: Demanding whatever they wanted, lying to people, and asking for freebies...
ja: 欲しい物は　何でもねだり　人にウソをつき　タダで物をもらおうとする……

key: Poor lady.
en: Poor lady.
ja: 気の毒な母親だ

key: I even heard her finally capitulate to the kid's demands to go to Agate Circus as they left.
en: I even heard her finally capitulate to the kid's demands to go to Agate Circus as they left.
ja: 帰りぎわには　アゲートサーカスへ行けという　子どものねだりに　とうとう　折れていたよ

key: A gentleman left the store with one the other day.
en: A gentleman left the store with one the other day.
ja: 先日　紳士が　ひとつ持って　店を出て行った

key: He seemed the intelligent type; someone in IT, surely.
en: He seemed the intelligent type; someone in IT, surely.
ja: 頭のよさそうな手合いだ　きっと　情報関係の仕事だろう

key: And yet, the way he was bundled up...
en: And yet, the way he was bundled up...
ja: それにしても　あの厚着ぶりときたら……

key: I suppose he must live in Ametrine City if he was prepared for that kind of cold.
en: I suppose he must live in Ametrine City if he was prepared for that kind of cold.
ja: あれほどの寒さに備えているなら　アメトリンシティに住んでいるのだろう

key: I saw a lady with green hair walk out of here with one just the other day.
en: I saw a lady with green hair walk out of here with one just the other day.
ja: 先日　緑の髪の女性が　ひとつ持って出るのを見た

key: Sharp dress, no restraint in her shopping habits...
en: Sharp dress, no restraint in her shopping habits...
ja: きちんとした身なりで　買い物にも　ためらいがない……

key: Yet she purchased household products in bulk...
en: Yet she purchased household products in bulk...
ja: それでいて　家庭用品を　まとめ買いしていた……

key: No doubt about it; she must be a real-estate agent.
en: No doubt about it; she must be a real-estate agent.
ja: 間違いない　不動産屋だな

key: You only get that kind of decisive spending from those folk.
en: You only get that kind of decisive spending from those folk.
ja: ああいう思いきった使い方をするのは　あの手の人間だけだ

key: From the accent colors and rustic products she was looking at, I'd guess her newest properties must be in Agate City.
en: From the accent colors and rustic products she was looking at, I'd guess her newest properties must be in Agate City.
ja: 見ていた品の　差し色や　かざり気のない作りからして　新しい物件は　アゲートシティだろう

key: It's obvious, if you think about it.
en: It's obvious, if you think about it.
ja: 考えてみれば　当たり前のことだ

key: Would you believe I saw a Gardevoir pick one up not too long ago!
en: Would you believe I saw a Gardevoir pick one up not too long ago!
ja: 信じられるか　少し前に　サーナイトが　ひとつ手にするのを見たんだ!

key: She seemed to be the docile type, simply doing shopping for her household.
en: She seemed to be the docile type, simply doing shopping for her household.
ja: おとなしい性格のようで　家のための買い物を　しているだけだった

key: The look of concern on her face...
en: The look of concern on her face...
ja: その顔に浮かんだ　心配の色……

key: The medicine in her bag...
en: The medicine in her bag...
ja: かばんの中の　薬……

key: The way she carefully avoided any products mentioning children...
en: The way she carefully avoided any products mentioning children...
ja: 子どもに関わる品を　注意深く　避けていたこと……

key: The way she assessed the weight of her items for the walk back...
en: The way she assessed the weight of her items for the walk back...
ja: 帰り道を考えて　荷物の重さを　見きわめていたこと……

key: And the subtle glance of remorse at the Pokémon care products...
en: And the subtle glance of remorse at the Pokémon care products...
ja: そして　ポケモン用品に向けた　かすかな悔いのまなざし……

key: It's plain as day--
en: It's plain as day--
ja: 答えは　明らかだ――

key: She must be taking care of a human owner in the Jasper Ward who's been bedridden after both the loss of her child and a precious Pokémon...
en: She must be taking care of a human owner in the Jasper Ward who's been bedridden after both the loss of her child and a precious Pokémon...
ja: ジャスパーワードで　子どもと　大切なポケモンを　同時に失って　寝こんでいる人間の主人を　世話しているに違いない……

key: I'm fully confident-- purely science and observational prowess.
en: I'm fully confident-- purely science and observational prowess.
ja: 自信がある――これは　純粋な科学と　観察の力だ

key: It is a unique craft, but I've surely mastered it.
en: It is a unique craft, but I've surely mastered it.
ja: めずらしい技だが　わたしは　完全に　身につけているのだ

key: Ah, but you have a full set, don't you?
en: Ah, but you have a full set, don't you?
ja: おや　きみは　全部そろえているのか?

key: Truly incredible how you managed to track all those down...
en: Truly incredible how you managed to track all those down...
ja: あれを全部　探し出すとは　本当に　おどろきだ……

key: I wonder how you could've found them all.
en: I wonder how you could've found them all.
ja: どうやって　全部見つけたのやら

key: Welcome! I can answer any questions you have about the Department Store's membership system.
en: Welcome! I can answer any questions you have about the Department Store's membership system.
ja: いらっしゃいませ! デパートの会員制度について　何でも　お答えします

key: Would you like to hear an explanation?
en: Would you like to hear an explanation?
ja: 説明を　お聞きになりますか?

key: Here at Obsidia, we sell everything a Trainer could possibly need, from Revives to Reaper Cloths!
en: Here at Obsidia, we sell everything a Trainer could possibly need, from Revives to Reaper Cloths!
ja: オブシディアでは　げんきのかけらから　れいかいのぬのまで　トレーナーに必要な物は　何でも　そろえています!

key: Unfortunately, many of our rarer items have a very limited stock.
en: Unfortunately, many of our rarer items have a very limited stock.
ja: ただ　珍しい商品は　在庫が　とても限られています

key: In order to prioritize our inventory for only our most loyal customers, the Obsidia Department Store has developed a membership system!
en: In order to prioritize our inventory for only our most loyal customers, the Obsidia Department Store has developed a membership system!
ja: 大切なお客様に　優先してお売りするため　オブシディアデパートでは　会員制度を　作りました!

key: Each customer is given a Membership Card on which they collect Stickers!
en: Each customer is given a Membership Card on which they collect Stickers!
ja: お客様には　シールを集めるための　メンバーズカードを　お渡しします!

key: Stickers are sometimes given out by Department Store staff, but also might be traded between other Trainers.
en: Stickers are sometimes given out by Department Store staff, but also might be traded between other Trainers.
ja: シールは　デパートの店員から　もらえることもあれば　トレーナー同士で　やり取りされることもあります

key: They are rare, but worth it! With each Sticker you collect, you'll be granted access to a new floor of the Department Store!
en: They are rare, but worth it! With each Sticker you collect, you'll be granted access to a new floor of the Department Store!
ja: 珍しいですが　その価値はあります! シールを1枚集めるごとに　新しい階へ　入れるようになります!

key: Happy collecting!
en: Happy collecting!
ja: 集めるのを　楽しんでくださいね!

key: Oh, don't you have a Membership Card yet? Please, take one! It comes with one Sticker already!
en: Oh, don't you have a Membership Card yet? Please, take one! It comes with one Sticker already!
ja: あら　まだメンバーズカードを　お持ちでない? どうぞ　お受け取りください! シールが1枚　ついています!

key: Very well. We hope you have a great shopping experience!
en: Very well. We hope you have a great shopping experience!
ja: かしこまりました。よい　お買い物を!

key: Don't you just love the feeling of having money to spare in a huge store like this?
en: Don't you just love the feeling of having money to spare in a huge store like this?
ja: こんな大きな店で　お金に余裕がある感じって　最高だと思わない?

key: Maybe someday I'll know it.
en: Maybe someday I'll know it.
ja: いつか　その気分を　味わってみたいな

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
